title: ArtifactManagerOutput
description: Output for the artifact_manager tool. Reports transfer and verification results.

ok.description: True if the copy-back completed and all required files are present.

verified_files.description: List of filenames that were verified to exist under local_path after transfer.

error.description: Error message if the transfer or verification failed, otherwise null.

bytes_transferred.description: Total bytes transferred during the copy-back, or null if not measured.
